Hello,

I have a DocType1 and a DocType2. DocType2 has a Link field to DocType1. Now I try to fetch information from linked document of DocType1 into DocType2 and keep them up to date.

Let’s say both DocTypes have a field Adress. Adress in DocType2 is “fetched from” linked the DocType1 document.

When I create a document of DocType2 and link to an instance of DocType1, I can see the fetched value for Adress. But the following problems occur:

  1. If I change the Adress field in DocType1, Adress of DocType2 is not automatically udpated. Why not? I would like to see the updated value in the list view of DocType2 without having to edit and refresh it again.
  2. If I make the Adress field in DocType2 virtual, I can see the fetched value when creating an instance of DocType2, but as soon as I save the value an leave the form, these fetched values are gone. They are not shown in the list view of DocType2 nor are they shown anymore if a edit a previously created DocType2 document.

How can I solve this?

Thanks for your help.

regards,
Robert
